Toyo Tanso.why: Sells graphite parts for single-crystal silicon manufacturing and SiC-coated graphite susceptors for Si and SiC epitaxy, consumables whose volumes follow wafer and epitaxy output.
Toyo Tanso.evidence: H1 results presentation (08-20-2026): 'robust demand for Si epitaxial applications, mainly for cutting-edge products for generative AI' for SiC-coated graphite products; 'Parts for single-crystal silicon manufacturing'

players.product: Special graphite parts for single-crystal silicon manufacturing and SiC-coated graphite products (susceptors) for Si and SiC epitaxial applications

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Tanso results presentation: Results for the First Half of the Fiscal Year Ending December 31, 2026 (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Toyo Tanso H1 of the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026: net sales JPY 22,370 million, down 2.7% YoY; operating profit JPY 1,778 million, down 53.7%, mainly due to lower marginal profit from changes in the sales mix and the recognition of unrealized profit in inventory.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 22,370 million net sales (-2.7%); JPY 1,778 million operating profit (-53.7%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Tanso results presentation: Results for the First Half of the Fiscal Year Ending December 31, 2026 (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Special graphite products for electronics applications H1: sales JPY 3,287 million, down 15.9% YoY, due to a substantial decline in parts for semiconductor device manufacturing and a slight decline in products for SiC compound semiconductor manufacturing and single-crystal silicon manufacturing applications, mainly due to continuing wafer inventory adjustments.

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Tanso results presentation: Results for the First Half of the Fiscal Year Ending December 31, 2026 (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: SiC-coated graphite products H1: sales decreased YoY; despite robust demand for Si epitaxial applications, mainly for cutting-edge products for generative AI, advance sales recorded in the previous fiscal year weighed on H1, in addition to a substantial decline in demand for SiC epitaxial applications. Three major products (SiC-coated graphite, C/C composites, graphite sheets) sales JPY 5,691 million (-13.7%).

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Tanso results presentation: Results for the First Half of the Fiscal Year Ending December 31, 2026 (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook: for Si semiconductor applications a full-scale recovery is expected from H2, as initially anticipated, with the completion of the current cycle of wafer inventory adjustments; orders for single-crystal silicon manufacturing applications and Si epitaxial applications have gradually recovered since Q1; for SiC, a very moderate improvement trend is apparent in orders, mainly for SiC epitaxial applications. H2 forecast for electronics applications JPY 4,728 million (+33.0% YoY).
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 4,728 million H2 forecast, electronics applications (+33.0%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Tanso results presentation: Results for the First Half of the Fiscal Year Ending December 31, 2026 (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Full-year forecast for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026 left unchanged: net sales JPY 49,000 million (+6.1%), operating profit JPY 6,200 million (-8.3%); H2 net sales JPY 26,629 million and operating profit JPY 4,421 million.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 49,000 million net sales; JPY 6,200 million operating profit

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Tanso results presentation: Results for the First Half of the Fiscal Year Ending December 31, 2026 (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: In response to rising manufacturing costs from increasing fuel prices (Middle East situation), Toyo Tanso plans a price revision effective for orders received from October 2026; capital investment, including purification and SiC/TaC coatings, is generally progressing as planned.
